en: This is a vintage postcard showing a street scene in a small European town. The image is monochrome and depicts a quiet intersection with several old buildings, one of which is labeled 'Hotel Roten Hirsch.' There are a few people, including children, visible on the street. The setting is quaint, with trees lining the square and overhead utility wires suggesting an early 20th-century timeframe. The caption at the bottom reads 'Dommitzsch a. d. Elbe. Leipzigerstraße.'
